topic.title: Highway Adoption / Section 38 / Section 278 / Public Maintenance
topic.source_contract: development and highway authority identity, road status, design standard, technical approval, section 38 or section 278 agreement, land title and dedication, bond, drainage and utilities, construction inspection, safety audit, defects period, as-built records, completion certificate and adoption evidence

scope_guards: Planning permission is not highway technical approval.
A draft agreement is not an executed section 38 or section 278 agreement.
Technical approval is not completed construction.
A bond is not highway adoption.
A completion certificate may precede final adoption.
Road use by the public is not proof of maintenance at public expense.
An adoption intention is not an adoption notice.
No score or promotion is written without exact agreement, construction, certificates, defects completion and adoption evidence.
